steps.title: Create Non-Destructive Project Snapshot Backup
steps.explanation: Full project configuration and HTML/Android source tree backed up prior to modifying Gradle or Manifest files.

steps.title: Analyze Gradle Wrapper Distribution
steps.explanation: Upgraded Gradle Wrapper to 8.11.1 required for Android Gradle Plugin 8.8.0 and API 36.

steps.title: Upgrade Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) & Kotlin Plugin
steps.beforeSnippet:
id("com.android.application") version "8.1.4" apply false
id("org.jetbrains.kotlin.android") version "1.9.10" apply false
steps.afterSnippet:
id("com.android.application") version "8.8.0" apply false
id("org.jetbrains.kotlin.android") version "2.1.0" apply false
steps.explanation: Aligned AGP 8.8.0 and Kotlin 2.1.0 with JDK 17/21 bytecode targets.

steps.title: Migrate compileSdk and targetSdk to API 36
steps.explanation: Updated compileSdk and targetSdk to API 36 (Android 16 Baklava).

steps.title: Upgrade AndroidX & WebKit Dependencies
steps.explanation: Upgraded AndroidX Core, Activity, and WebKit libraries for API 36 compatibility.

steps.title: Enforce Android 15/16 Edge-to-Edge Window Insets
steps.explanation: Android 15+ enforces edge-to-edge rendering by default. Added WindowInsetsCompat padding listener so WebView content is never obscured by system bars.

steps.title: Enable Predictive Back Gesture Support
steps.explanation: Replaced legacy onBackPressed() with OnBackPressedDispatcher callback and enabled predictive back animations for Android 15/16.

steps.title: Harden WebView Asset Loading (Replace file:// with WebViewAssetLoader)
steps.explanation: Eliminated unsafe file:// WebView access flagged by Google Play security scanners while preserving full offline CORS-compatible local asset loading.

steps.title: Preserve Application ID & Increment Version Code
steps.explanation: Preserved existing applicationId (id.nusantara.poscatalog) for Play Store update continuity and incremented versionCode from 34 to 35.
